xBRIEFInfo.description: Story 1 of #3434: implement ADR-005 design-critique judgment gate (advisory only)

plan.title: design-critique judgment gate (ADR-005) — marker, policy entry, clearance line; advisory only

narratives.Description: Implement Phase 1 of the design-critique motion from ADR-005 only. Stamp a machine-readable marker, match it with a plan.policy.judgmentGates entry, and document the clearance line. Advisory tier. Do not wire --enforce. Do not create the skill.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3434 Story 1. Sole spec: docs/decisions/ADR-005-design-critique-judgment-gate.md (merged PR #3576). Do not ingest other #3434 comments as spec.
narratives.Overview: ADR-005: the gate never computes whether triage is mechanism-shaped. The author stamps that judgment. A judgmentGates entry matches the marker syntactically. The engine fails closed only on a missing clearance line, never on its content. Three pieces of declared data. Rollout advise then observe then block. This story ships the advisory observe surface only.
narratives.UserStory: As a triage author, I want a stamped mechanism-shaped marker plus a matching judgmentGates entry and a recorded clearance line, so that omission of the design-critique gate is detectable without a semantic classifier.
narratives.When: When a triage write-back carries the stamped marker (body-text field and mirrored label), the declared judgmentGates entry matches it, and a clearance line of the form design-critique: warranted | not warranted, because ... is documented. verify:judgment-gates without --enforce stays advisory. scope:promote does not gain --enforce in this story.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Sole spec is ADR-005. Parameters: marker = write-back field + mirrored label; --enforce attach point is scope:promote but this story does not wire --enforce; clearance is model-recordable with human review at promote. Four refusals: do not compute classification; do not evaluate clearance content; do not mandate critique without the marker; do not start at --enforce. Do not create content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique. Do not close #3434.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add a declared plan.policy.judgmentGates entry in xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json matching the marker via existing predicates (labels and/or body-text) per packages/core/src/orchestration/judgment-policy.ts. Add the stamp field plus mirrored label to the #1423 triage write-back format and ISSUE_LABELS.md (or the existing label catalog). Document the clearance-line convention where the ADR requires it (ADR Consequences / clearance presence-shape-authority). Tests that the gate matches the marker and stays advisory without --enforce. CHANGELOG Unreleased. Targeted tests around judgment-gates and triage write-back.

narrative.Acceptance: When plan.policy.judgmentGates is loaded, a declared design-critique gate matches the stamped marker via labels and/or body-text predicates and uses advisory/review tier, not block-plus-enforce.
